# Atheryon

> Atheryon supports financial-services leaders across M&A, data and AI-enabled transformation. The firm helps institutions make high-stakes decisions and deliver execution that stands up to regulatory, operational and market scrutiny.

This document is the canonical machine-readable rendering of the Atheryon site, structured for AI agents interpreting capability and structure.

## Functions

Atheryon operates across two functions:

- M&A Transaction Services (led by Anna Contos): https://atheryon.com.au/ma — "Making Transactions Executable". Transaction readiness, separation and integration strategy, execution leadership, and technology, data and migration readiness.
- Data, Transformation, AI (led by Terry Tsakiris): https://atheryon.com.au/data-ai — data platforms, transformation programs and AI-assisted delivery where evidence and operating data decide the outcome.

## Sectors

Both functions are engaged across four sectors: capital markets, banking, wealth and non-bank financial institutions. Sectors describe the audience; they are not separate pages.

## Site map

- [Home](https://atheryon.com.au/): executive landing — "Clarity for critical decisions. Leadership for complex execution."; track record, the two functions, co-founders.
- [M&A Transaction Services](https://atheryon.com.au/ma): the function's offer and method, from pre-sign insight through Day 1 readiness to operational independence and TSA exit.
- [Data, Transformation, AI](https://atheryon.com.au/data-ai): the function's offer and method, including embedded senior specialists and AI-assisted delivery patterns.
- [Supply Chain](https://atheryon.com.au/data-ai/supply-chain): supply chain work on the Data & AI foundation — business process re-engineering and governed AI for regulated sectors, including pharmaceutical and health.
- [Experience](https://atheryon.com.au/experience): representative cases across both functions, normalised to Context / Role / Outcome.
- [About](https://atheryon.com.au/about): firm story and co-founder biographies (Anna Contos, Terry Tsakiris).
- [Contact](https://atheryon.com.au/contact): single enquiry path.

## Data, Transformation, AI depth

- [System](https://atheryon.com.au/system): reference architecture for the platform work.
- [Labs](https://atheryon.com.au/labs): the working reference platform.
- [Themes](https://atheryon.com.au/themes): platform themes by banking function.
- [Offers](https://atheryon.com.au/offers): platform licensing and engagement paths (code, prompts, consult).
